metaData.originalTitle: 腾讯混元 AI Infra 新开源：HPC-Ops 推理核心算子全面升级
metaData.title: Tencent Hunyuan AI Infra New Open Source: Comprehensive Upgrade of HPC-Ops Inference Core Operators
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan open-sources a major upgrade to its HPC-Ops inference operator library, introducing five core operators including Attention dynamic scheduling, Router GEMM dual BF16 high-precision computation, and FusedMoE full pipeline, with multiple performance metrics surpassing mainstream baselines and end-to-end QPM improved by 30%.
metaData.summary: This article is an official release from the Tencent Hunyuan AI Infra team regarding a major upgrade to its open-source inference operator library, HPC-Ops. It details the technical principles, design concepts, and performance data of five core operators: Attention adopts runtime dynamic load scheduling to address long-tail latency, achieving a 2.95x speedup for long-text scenarios; Router GEMM uses a dual BF16 combination to simulate FP32 precision, achieving up to a 3.22x speedup over FP32 cuBLAS while maintaining high accuracy; FusedMoE integrates the entire MoE inference process into a unified pipeline, delivering a 1.2x-1.6x performance improvement over vLLM/SGLang; Fused AllReduce+Norm deeply fuses communication and normalization computation, achieving up to a 1.68x speedup; Sampler fuses over a dozen kernels into 2, achieving a 4.0x-7.5x speedup over vLLM. All capabilities are derived from Tencent Hunyuan's online production practices and have been fully open-sourced.

mainPoints.point: HPC-Ops has evolved from individual operators to a system-level optimization capability set covering the entire inference pipeline.
mainPoints.explanation: This upgrade focuses on five core operators: Attention, Router GEMM, FusedMoE, Fused AllReduce+Norm, and Sampler, shifting from single-point performance optimization to full-link collaborative optimization, resulting in a 30% end-to-end QPM improvement.

mainPoints.point: The Attention dynamic scheduling solution effectively addresses the long-tail latency issue caused by mixed-length request batching.
mainPoints.explanation: Through tile-level splitting, global load balancing, and a greedy bin-packing algorithm, it achieves a 1.59x-1.76x speedup in mixed-length batch scenarios and up to a 2.95x speedup in single-batch long-text scenarios.

mainPoints.point: Router GEMM achieves FP32-level precision with a dual BF16 combination, balancing accuracy and performance.
mainPoints.explanation: It splits FP32 weights into high-bit and low-bit residual BF16 tensors, performs two BF16 GEMM operations during inference, and combines them linearly. Its precision significantly surpasses TF32, with performance up to 3.22x faster than FP32 cuBLAS.

mainPoints.point: FusedMoE significantly reduces MoE inference overhead through a full-operator pipeline reconstruction.
mainPoints.explanation: It fuses five stages—routing, Gate-Up GEMM, activation quantization, Down GEMM, and Top-K aggregation—into a unified pipeline, eliminating memory copy and kernel launch overhead, achieving a 1.2x-1.6x performance improvement over mainstream frameworks.

mainPoints.point: Sampler eliminates post-processing performance bottlenecks through extreme large-kernel fusion.
mainPoints.explanation: It fuses over a dozen fragmented kernels into 2 CUDA kernels through full-process kernel fusion, fine-grained parallelism, and computation chain consolidation, achieving a 4.0x-7.5x speedup over vLLM.

keyQuotes: HPC-Ops has fully evolved from a single high-performance operator library into a system-level inference optimization capability set that covers the entire large model inference process, balances precision and speed, and is adapted for large-scale production deployment.

All optimization capabilities in this release are derived from the long-term online production practices of the Tencent Hunyuan AI Infra team, deeply adapted to real, complex large-scale inference business scenarios.

relatedArticles.title: Tencent Hunyuan 3D World Model 2.0 Released: Seamless Integration with Game Workflows
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan has officially open-sourced its 3D world model HY-World 2.0. This model can generate editable 3D assets with physical collision from text, image, or video input in one click, and seamlessly import them into game engines like Unity/UE, significantly lowering the barrier for creating game maps and level prototypes.

relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: A conversation with top AI scientist Yuandong Tian, exploring organizational challenges in the LLM race, research taste, fundamental breakthroughs in inference efficiency, and the evolution of the AI industry by 2026.

relatedArticles.title: LLM Training You Didn't Know: Principles, Paths, and New Practices - Tw93
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically outlines the full-stack architecture of LLM training in 2026, providing an in-depth analysis of key technical decisions and engineering practices ranging from pre-training, data engineering, and post-training to Agent training and Harness optimization.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: Essential for Travel! Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources Offline Translation Model for Mobile, Only 0.4GB, Supporting 33 Languages
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced an extremely quantized offline translation model for mobile, Hy-MT1.5-1.8B. Using 2-bit and 1.25-bit compression techniques, the model size is reduced to 440MB, supporting offline translation in 33 languages with quality surpassing Google Translate.

relatedArticles.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources New Translation Model Hy-MT2, Mini-Program 'Tencent Hy Translation' Now Available for Experience
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan open-sources its next-generation translation model Hy-MT2, supporting 33 languages. The 7B and 30B-A3B models achieve state-of-the-art open-source results, while the 1.8B model surpasses mainstream commercial APIs. A mini-program and app of the same name have also been launched.

relatedArticles.title: First Token Latency Reduced by 3.6x: Tencent Hunyuan Proposes Stem Sparse Attention Algorithm, New SOTA for Long-Context Inference Acceleration
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan proposes the Stem sparse attention algorithm, which, through two key innovations—Token Position Decay and Output-Aware Metric—approaches the accuracy of dense attention using only 25% of the compute. Combined with HPC operators, it achieves a 3.7x reduction in first token latency for 128K context, and has been accepted by ICML 2026.

relatedArticles.title: Hy-Memory Launch: Building a Supercharged Second Brain for Agent Memory
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tencent Hunyuan launches Hy-Memory, a memory plugin designed for Openclaw Agent, featuring a 6-layer memory framework, System1/System2 dual systems, and an evolution chain mechanism to address memory fragmentation, information loss, and cognitive iteration issues in long-term collaboration scenarios.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro Launch: A Flagship Foundation Model for the Agent Era
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaomi has released its flagship foundation model, MiMo-V2-Pro, tailored for Agent scenarios. It features 1T parameters, a 1M context window, cost-effective API pricing, and deep integration within the Xiaomi and Kingsoft Office ecosystems.

relatedArticles.title: GLM-5.2 Released and Open-Sourced: Focused on Coding and Long-Horizon Tasks
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI released and open-sourced GLM-5.2, focusing on Coding and long-horizon tasks. It achieved first place globally in the Code Arena blind test, and with its 1M context and open-source SOTA performance, it is now the strongest open-source Coding model.
